item.description:
New

  • Group cells in the Custom Grid Builder. Click the cells you want together, press Group, and they become one zone — so a 4×3 grid can be two tall columns beside a stack of four small ones. Hotkeys, arrow-key cycling and Drag to Snap all follow the grouped shape.
  • Custom grids can now be up to 5 rows by 5 columns.

Changed

  • Clicking a cell in the builder now selects it rather than snapping the front window, since a click has to mean one thing and grouping needs it. To try a layout, save it first and click its miniature in the preset list or the menu bar.
